sections.title: Caring, confidential, *in business since 1965*
body: Hal's Hair Center is a full-service hair replacement and restoration center. Our caring, confidential hair loss counseling gives you what you need to make a fully informed decision about which treatment is best for your particular hair loss.
With hair restoration there are lots of options to consider, but only one phone call you need to make.
list: Free, no-obligation hair loss and scalp evaluation
Discreet, private, dignified and confidential service
Totally private styling rooms for both men and women
Convenient location with private, off-street parking
Member of Transitions Hair Loss Centers and the American Hair Loss Council
